sections.heading: Information We Collect
body: When you book a fitting, place an order, or contact us, we collect your name, phone number, email address, and — where relevant to your order — body measurements and fit notes.
Our website may also collect basic analytics data such as pages visited and general location, used only to understand site usage.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
body: Measurement and fit data is used solely to produce and adjust your garments and is kept on file so future orders don't require a repeat measuring session.
Contact details are used to confirm bookings, share order updates, and — only with your consent — send occasional style updates by email.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
body: We do not sell your personal information. Measurement and order data is never shared with third parties outside of the payment processors required to complete your transaction.

sections.heading: Your Rights
body: You may request a copy of the data we hold on you, ask us to correct it, or request deletion of your measurement file at any time by emailing hello@lipekfashion.com.

seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: How Lipek Fashion collects, uses and protects your personal and measurement data.
